phase: pricing gate (stopped before any Adam step)

arms.treatment: N alignment structure x (selection CE + order-decoy margin, m = 1.0)
arms.control: N alignment structure x selection CE only

design.only_variable: the objective (margin term present or absent); structure, init, data order, LR, clip and update count are shared
design.decoy_rule: gold record key split at its character midpoint with the two halves swapped; byte multiset, byte length and byte inventory identical, only the order differs
design.margin_term: per example 2 content starts (object start 3 / place start 21), one order decoy each; loss = mean(relu(1.0 - (score_gold - score_decoy))); the decoy key is binding.base.relation.pool(binding.base.relation.encode_units(subject, decoy))

training.data_order: h.schedule(train, 30), identical batches for both arms

pricing_gate.note: the fixed design cannot fit the 400 CPU cap on this machine even with zero overhead: training floor + three full 192-example snapshots already exceed it; nothing was trained and no bundle was written
pricing_gate.formula: estimate = ((30*ce_unit + 30*(ce_unit+margin_unit)) + 3*snapshot_estimate + 2*reading_cpu + save_overhead + cpu_already_spent) * 1.15; every unit is the steady-state (second) measurement of the same operation

units.steady_state_units: the second measurement of each unit is used for the estimate; the first (cold) measurement is reported for transparency

arms.treatment: N x (selection CE + order-decoy margin), 0/30 updates
arms.control: N x selection CE only, 0/30 updates

attribution_verdict.reason: pricing gate stopped the run before any Adam step
attribution_verdict.priority_rule: 1) key_diff drop > 20% versus 1.491 -> washout_upstream; 2) margin median still <= -0.003 or improvement < 0.01 -> margin_not_trainable_in_30; 3) otherwise washout_at_readout_proven
